resharper_apply_on_completion #

Undocumented ReSharper property; classified as C#-relevant by vocabulary. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified not a formatter option.
